resources.string:
App rules:
• Apps, website/domain rules, and in-app sections are managed per profile, each with its own Block selected / Allow selected mode.
• Use the app list below for whole-app blocking or allowing.
• Use Website/domain rules for browser rules in the active profile.
• Use In-app sections for supported installed apps like YouTube, Instagram, X, and Snapchat.

Which apps are available:
• The normal list shows apps currently installed on this device that Android exposes with a regular launcher entry. Switchly can therefore manage most regular launchable apps; it is not a catalog of every Android app.
• Apps without a launcher entry, hidden system components, and apps that are not installed are normally not shown. A previously selected app can remain listed as Unavailable after it is removed.
• Switchly itself remains excluded. Safety-sensitive apps such as the active launcher, keyboard, dialer, Google app, package installer, permission controller, and System UI are marked Protected. They are skipped by Select all, but can be selected individually after a clear risk warning.
• The exact list can vary slightly by Android version, manufacturer, work profile, and package-visibility restrictions.

Block selected:
• Selected apps are blocked while this profile is active.
• Apps not selected here are allowed unless another limit blocks them.

Allow selected:
• Apps in this picker list are allowed only when selected.
• Apps in this picker list that are not selected are blocked.
• Apps not shown in the picker are treated as allowed because they cannot be selected here.

Automatically block newly installed apps:
• Only available in Block selected mode.
• When enabled, newly installed launchable apps are added to this profile automatically.
• Select all also turns this on for future installs.
This profile is in Allow selected mode, but no apps are selected. Listed picker apps may be blocked, but apps not shown in the picker are treated as allowed.
